facts: Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands is a 1996 graphic adventure game.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands was developed by Zombie LLC.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands was published by Activision.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands is the eleventh game in the Zork series.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands is the first title in the Zork series not to appear under the Infocom label.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands features a darker, less comical story within the Zork setting.
The story of Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands focuses on players investigating the sudden disappearance of four prominent figures and their children.
The disappearances in Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands were at the hands of a mysterious being known as the "Nemesis".
The story of Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands includes uncovering a sinister plot during the players' investigations.
Players in Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands must thwart a sinister plot.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands was released for Windows 95.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands was ported to MS - DOS by Quicksilver Software.
Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands was ported to Macintosh by Quicksilver Software.
The MS - DOS version of Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands has been released by GOG on their website.
GOG made the MS - DOS version of Zork Nemesis : The Forbidden Lands compatible for use with Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, and Windows 10.
